step.cmd: Determine if the documentation includes all the coding information needed to input the training:

ul.li: If no, contact your Business Expertise Advisor for guidance on how to enter the referred training.

step.cmd: Determine if there is a pending electronic claimant’s report on the E-Report tab for the period before the training period:

ul.li: If yes, refer to Actioning a pending claimant’s report and go to step 3. Actioning a pending claimant’s report

step.cmd: Determine if there are any rejected electronic claimant’s reports on the Pending/Reject tab for the period before the training period:

ul.li: If yes, re-input the claimant’s reports. Refer to Actioning a rejected claimant’s report and go to step 4. Actioning a rejected claimant’s report

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there is a registration number for the issue:

ul.li: If no, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operation Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 36 - Special benefits on Fishing claims or other complex claim conditions .
Remarks Line 2: Type “T171 — STRT-WK/DY [the course start w/c], END-WK-DY [the course end w/c].”

Remarks Line 3: Type “PROJ-HRRC [the Responsibility Centre code or institution code, if applicable], PROJ-NO [the 10-digit agreement number; use preceding zeros if the number is less than 10 digits] TRAIN-ID [the training ID code], BREAK START/END WK [the w/c code of any break weeks].”

Remarks Line 4: Type “Type of benefits to be paid, if not already on the claim. (Mat — w/c xxxx-xxxx, Par — w/c xxxx-xxxx, family caregiver weeks or CCB weeks to be paid.” If applicable, type “[NO-CR]”, [claimant’s report information], or [MA rescind information].”

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction to transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: In NWS, create a ROD as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “Entitlement in order — EIA 25 referral.”
Details: Type “The client can continue receiving payment of special benefits while attending an approved course of instruction under EIA 25 (National Policy on Levels of Decision).”
